title: Costmap Layers: What Is Known to Be There, What Was Just Seen, and What Is Too Close to It, Kept Apart so That Each Can Be Cleared Without Losing the Others

artifact.note: a grid of costs (free, a gradient, inscribed, lethal, unknown) in layers: a static layer rasterised from walls and posts, an obstacle layer that marks the cells where points were seen and clears the cells a beam passed through, and an inflation layer that spreads cost round every lethal cell by the footprint of the robot; the layers combine by taking the highest cost
